_readme: Which picture represents each milestone group in the diagram.
title   - the English Wikipedia page whose lead image is used.
caption - shown under the picture in the app; describes the GROUP, not the photo.
file    - optional override: an exact Wikimedia Commons file name ('Lion waiting in Namibia.jpg').
Use this whenever the Wikipedia lead image is a diagram, a collage or a poor photo.
check   - true means the lead image is probably a diagram or collage: look at it before shipping.
The fetcher reports every entry marked 'check' at the end of a run.

life.title: Life
life.caption: Everything alive shares one starting point

metazoa.title: Animal
metazoa.caption: One of the animals - the group this whole tree sits inside

bilateria.title: Bilateria
bilateria.caption: An animal with a left and a right side

chordata.title: Chordate
chordata.caption: A chordate: an animal with a stiffening rod down its back

vertebrata.title: Vertebrate
vertebrata.caption: A vertebrate: an animal with a backbone

chondrichthyes.title: Chondrichthyes
chondrichthyes.caption: A fish whose skeleton is made of cartilage

teleostei.title: Teleost
teleostei.caption: A teleost: most of the fish you can name

sarcopterygii.title: Sarcopterygii
sarcopterygii.caption: A lobe-finned fish, the group land animals came from

amniota.title: Amniote
amniota.caption: An amniote: it lays eggs on land or gives birth

marsupialia.title: Marsupial
marsupialia.caption: A marsupial: its young finish growing in a pouch

rodentia.title: Rodent
rodentia.caption: A rodent: teeth that never stop growing

chiroptera.title: Bat
chiroptera.caption: A bat: the only mammal that truly flies

pinnipedia.title: Pinniped
pinnipedia.caption: A seal, sea lion or walrus

artiodactyla.title: Even-toed ungulate
artiodactyla.caption: An even-toed hoofed animal - whales belong here too

sauropsida.title: Reptile
sauropsida.caption: A reptile - a group that includes the birds

aves.title: Bird
aves.caption: A bird - the dinosaurs that are still here

arthropoda.title: Arthropod
arthropoda.caption: An arthropod: jointed legs and a hard outer shell

arachnida.title: Arachnid
arachnida.caption: An arachnid: eight legs, no antennae

insecta.title: Insect
insecta.caption: An insect: six legs, usually wings

malacostraca.title: Malacostraca
malacostraca.caption: A crab, lobster, shrimp or woodlouse

cephalopoda.title: Cephalopod
cephalopoda.caption: An octopus, squid, cuttlefish or nautilus

bivalvia.title: Bivalvia
bivalvia.caption: A shellfish with two hinged shells

echinodermata.title: Echinoderm
echinodermata.caption: A starfish, urchin or sea cucumber

porifera.title: Sponge
porifera.caption: A sponge: an animal with no organs at all
